description: Road Resurfacing Map (through 2021) is a dataset listed in Analyzejerseycity open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Engineering, Traffic & Transportation. This dataset is linked to the following visualization: Visualization - Road Resurfacing Map (through 2021) A printable, zoomable, filterable map of all road work performed (or planned) on Jersey City roads from 2008 through 2021 The map is more recent than the supplementary files below. View MAP in FULL COLOR here. Coverage: Jersey City, New Jersey. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are Paving, Streets, Road, Resurface, Map, Vision Zero. The portal shows 850 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-12-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-jerseycitynj-gov-portal.
